# jaff.physics.photo_reactions.shielding.config

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Config of the photo-reaction line shielding (`shielding` tables).

A `shielding` table names a shielding plugin by `type`; its other keys are
that plugin's settings, checked by the plugin's `config_model()` (a
`ShieldingParams` subclass) once the reaction it applies to is known.

## Classes

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ShieldingConfig`](shieldingconfig/index.md) | Shielding of a photo reaction (a `shielding` table). |
| [`ShieldingParams`](shieldingparams/index.md) | Base of the settings of one shielding type (every key but `type`). |

## Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`check_shielding`](check_shielding.md) | Check *shielding* against its plugin, for *reaction* (`None`: global). |
